scope: All Commonwealth terrestrial travel paths, across seven Atlas physical zones; not a blanket prohibition on existing bridges, docks, quays, buildings or private interior/yard finishes.
rule: Unpaved, location-specific terrain paths; no asphalt/concrete paved carriageways, painted traffic lanes or modern highway guardrails as generic road dressing. Natural exposed bedrock is not paving. Engineered crossings and other existing structures retain their established identities.
